summary: In this excerpt from Book 6, part 27, Arthur, Pilar, Checker and the narrator discuss Dr. Xiaohu Zhang, an NSA mathematician who knows Professor Halliday and whom Pilar is described as vouching for. They debate involving the NSA rather than the Pasadena police, weighing the stolen proof of a possible economic apocalypse and the need to find Professor Sonya. Arthur decides Pilar should approach Zhang first, while keeping Russell and Checker out of the official picture, and the group turns to the SUV that tried to kill them, now in police impound, and to tracking a van.
one_line: Arthur and his companions decide Pilar should approach NSA mathematician Xiaohu Zhang for help in finding the kidnapped Professor Sonya.
key_facts: Dr. Xiaohu Zhang has a PhD from Berkeley and has worked as a mathematician for the NSA for almost twenty years.
Pilar says Zhang and Professor Halliday likely know each other from way back at Berkeley.
Pilar reports that Zhang has no irregular bank accounts, has a wife and three kids, and volunteers planting trees and coaching Little League.
Checker describes the NSA as a government spy organization with far too much power and far too little oversight.
Checker notes that the police had already been called in and that the NSA would likely be involved sooner or later.
Checker says the proof of the possible economic apocalypse was stolen before the group arrived at the scene.
Arthur says Sonya's safety is his only concern and that he would rather she be in trouble with the Feds than hurt.
Zhang has taken the day off to chaperone his daughter's class trip to the tar pits.
Arthur tells Pilar to be honest with Zhang and to say he is on his way but sent her first.
Arthur instructs Pilar to leave Russell and Checker out of it so they can keep investigating without government interference.
Pilar says she will keep looking into the matter a little longer before joining with the Feds.
Checker reports that the SUV that tried to kill the group has been taken to police impound.
Arthur says he will pull strings to get access to examine the SUV in impound.
The narrator asks for Cas's help with the van tracking.
